entries.issuing_body: California Department of Financial Protection and Innovation
entries.title: California's financial regulator is reported to have filed a comment letter opposing the SEC's proposed Regulation Crypto Assets
entries.facts: Trade coverage published October 21, 2026 reports that the California Department of Financial Protection and Innovation filed a comment letter objecting to the Securities and Exchange Commission's proposed Regulation Crypto Assets, which would exempt certain digital-asset offerings from securities registration. The coverage states that the department argues the exemptions could supersede state registration requirements and limit California's ability to apply its own securities laws, and that the letter warns investors could lose protections against fraudulent or abusive offerings. The coverage does not state the letter's filing date, gives no file number and quotes no passage of the letter. A law-firm regulatory tracker dated October 22, 2026 separately records the same event and dates it October 22, 2026. The proposal is SEC File No. S7-2026-27, RIN 3235-AN38, and its comment period closed October 20, 2026. The department's own press release announcing the letter could not be retrieved, and no corresponding comment document was located on the SEC docket.
entries.source_label: TokenPost (trade coverage) - DFPI press release and SEC docket entry not retrieved
entries.relevant_to: token issuers, crypto exchanges, state-licensed digital-asset firms, securities counsel
